extension.summary: Films and TV with Trakt, TMDB and Premiumize
extension.description: SpongeTV brings Trakt syncing, TMDB metadata, Premiumize and your own provider packages together in one add-on. This is a stage 4 test build: browsing, metadata, Trakt, provider packages and playback through Premiumize.
extension.disclaimer: SpongeTV includes no content providers. You are responsible for the provider packages you install.
extension.news: 0.5.4: After you watch something to the end, SpongeTV now waits for Kodi to finish saving its own record of the video before reloading the list, so an episode you've just finished shouldn't flash up as part-watched. Kodi's log notes when Kodi saved, when the list reloaded, and how the item you watched shows afterwards. 0.5.3: An episode or film you've finished no longer shows as part-watched because of an old resume point Kodi kept for itself. When you're signed in to Trakt, SpongeTV now tells Kodi there's no resume point, rather than leaving Kodi to fill in its own. 0.5.2: Fixes an error opening a season when an episode had both SpongeTV's own resume point and Trakt's (a fault in how Kodi's Python reads dates, introduced in 0.4.20). Also stops a meaningless "no show came with its seasons" error in Kodi's log after syncing resume points. 0.5.1: Settings, Accounts now shows who you're signed in as: "Signed in as <name>" for Trakt, and your premium days left for Premiumize. Only the buttons that apply show: Sign in when you're signed out, Sign out (and Check Premiumize account) when you're signed in. Earlier changes: changelog.txt
